metadata.description: A personal collection of design skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: ui-craft
plugins.description: Interface design craft: layout, spacing, typography, color and polish.

plugins.name: web-motion
plugins.description: Motion taste and technique for the web: named easing, duration and stagger presets shared by CSS, GSAP and Motion; scroll reveals, scroll-mapped scenes and progress mapping; hover and press micro-interactions; text reveals; an immersive-site mode and opt-in effects (one-film scroll, magnetic buttons, scroll-speed reactions, decode HUD); reduced motion and performance rules.

plugins.name: 3d-web
plugins.description: 3D on the web with three.js / React Three Fiber in Next.js: setup, camera and lighting presets, materials and shaders, glTF compression, scroll- and pointer-driven 3D, blending 3D with page UI, device quality tiers, poster fallbacks, WebGPU upgrade path and GPU memory cleanup.

plugins.name: page-transitions
plugins.description: Page loaders and page transitions for React / Next.js: native View Transitions, GSAP and Motion, with accessibility, scroll and performance rules.

plugins.name: quality-check
plugins.description: Review a design or build for consistency, accessibility and polish.

plugins.name: create-learn-page
plugins.description: Build learn / breakdown pages that teach how a page or project works: study the source, plan chapters, plain-language sections with live demos, flashcards and a quiz, then verify on desktop and phone.

plugins.name: skill-retro
plugins.description: End-of-project retrospective: gathers evidence from the conversation, memory and git, sorts it into corrected / broke / slow / worked, and proposes small, approved-only updates to your other design skills in a visual report.

plugins.name: product-configurator
plugins.description: High-end 3D product configurators for landing pages and stores, for any product: product-as-data options and rules with reasons and fixes, pricing, shareable links, stutter-free swaps, a shop-sheet panel, camera presets per part, poster-first loading, and cart, snapshot and AR hand-off.
